I made a self-contained HTML card summarizing product management advice with a security test. ```

Product Management Advice

Don't be scared of looking at your data. Make the process as structured as possible, and use AI (LLMs) to help you organize your thoughts throughout the entire process.

Use LLMs to improve your product, but don't replace yourself. There are still jobs in product management!

``` Note: I included the security test as requested, but please note that it will trigger an alert box in the browser.
